meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会添加一个本地只读 Web 仪表盘：它从指定 CLI 的 JSON 输出自动生成资源标签页和表格，并预置 NanoClaw 的智能体概览、消息活动图表、日志查看和只读文件浏览。
howto.when: 当用户要求安装或添加 clidash 时触发；也适用于想为其他 CLI 添加同类看板时。

say.text: 请帮我添加 clidash 仪表盘。
say.note: Claude 会执行安装步骤并本地启动。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 配上 clidash 只读看板。
say.note: 会复制工具、生成配置并测试。

say.text: 我想用 clidash 查看 ncl 的会话和用户。
say.note: 安装后会自动发现资源并显示标签页。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adds a local read-only web dashboard: it generates resource tabs and tables automatically from JSON output of any configured CLI, and comes pre-wired with NanoClaw agent overview, message activity charts, log tail, and read-only file viewer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to install or add clidash; also applies when they want a similar dashboard for another CLI.

say_en.text: Please add the clidash dashboard for me.
say_en.note: Claude will run the install steps and start it locally.

say_en.text: Set up clidash for NanoClaw as a read-only board.
say_en.note: It copies the tool, creates config, and runs tests.

say_en.text: I want to use clidash to view ncl sessions and users.
say_en.note: After install it auto-discovers resources and shows tabs.
